usedFor: MSG91 holds support tickets, and Upvoted collects feature requests when “New Ticket Arrives” runs “Create Feature”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Ticket Arrives” in MSG91, then “Create Feature” in Upvoted
bestTemplate.why: A ticket becomes a feature people can vote on, so requests reach your board.

watchOut: “New Ticket Arrives” is polling and covers every ticket, so “Create Feature” also gets tickets that are not requests.
